items.title: Market drawdown vs. downturn: Watch the fundamentals
items.summary: Market drawdowns, often triggered by policy uncertainty, are distinct from market downturns, which signal the end of a market cycle due to deteriorating fundamentals. While drawdowns have occurred recently due to tariffs and geopolitical events, key indicators like tight credit spreads and strong small-cap performance suggest the structural bull market remains intact. Investors should focus on fundamental factors such as earnings and AI investment rather than short-term policy concerns.

items.title: Kroger records strong private label growth as shoppers stay focused on savings
items.summary: Kroger reported strong private label sales growth in its second fiscal quarter of 2026, outperforming national brands as shoppers prioritize value. CEO Greg Foran highlighted robust demand for value-oriented products, including the Private Selection line, and emphasized the company's commitment to acting as the "customer's agent" by scrutinizing supplier price increases. Despite flat identical store sales, Kroger aims for growth driven by value rather than inflation.

items.title: DeFi Technologies Inc. (CN:DEFI) Gains Momentum as Digital-Asset Sentiment Improves and Platform Catalysts Build
items.summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. (CN:DEFI) saw an 11.69% increase in its stock price on September 11, 2026, driven by improving digital-asset sentiment and technical buying, rather than a specific company announcement. The company, which provides regulated access to cryptocurrencies and institutional trading services through its Valour and Stillman Digital segments, is benefiting from continued investor interest and institutional client development despite volatile market conditions. While the Nasdaq compliance extension offers some relief, risks like market volatility, regulatory changes, and geopolitical tensions remain for the company.

items.title: Exxon Mobil's Joliet refinery reports upset due to power outage
items.summary: Exxon Mobil's Joliet refinery experienced a power outage on Sunday afternoon, triggering its safety flare. The 264,000-barrel-per-day refinery supplies key fuels to the U.S. Midwest, and the incident comes amidst a tight global fuel market. The cause of the outage is currently under investigation.

items.title: Chevron eyes Argentina, Mediterranean for global LNG growth, deal with India
items.summary: Chevron plans to expand its global gas portfolio in regions like Argentina and the Mediterranean to meet increasing demand for energy security. The company aims to diversify its supply and contracting structures following recent disruptions in global gas markets. Chevron is also looking for future opportunities in Australia and Africa, and hopes to secure a deal in India, while also weighing investments in Venezuela.

items.title: Kroger Q2 Earnings Call Highlights Softer Sales, Firm Profit View
items.summary: Kroger's Q2 fiscal 2026 earnings call revealed softer sales momentum, leading management to lower its identical-sales outlook. Despite this, the company maintained its profit targets, emphasizing cost discipline and customer value through savings reinvestment. Key drivers for profitability included cost savings, pharmacy margins, e-commerce growth, and media revenue, even as consumer spending faced pressure from inflation and reduced SNAP benefits.

items.title: Kroger loses billions in customer spending to Walmart, Amazon and Costco, report finds
items.summary: Kroger and its associated brands have lost over $12 billion in consumer packaged goods spending to competitors like Amazon, Walmart, and Costco in the past year, according to a Numerator analysis. This decline is largely due to lower-income households becoming more cautious with their spending and making fewer trips to Kroger stores. Despite a gain in higher-income shoppers and strong private-label sales, Kroger has lowered its full-year outlook, expecting continued pressure on consumer spending.
